title: Requests awaiting a reviewer
description: Authorized workspace reviewers can take responsibility for an unassigned request. This does not approve disclosure or a data change.
liveWarning: This queue changes as reviewers act. Taking a case rechecks its availability.
recorded: Assignment receipt recorded. Refresh the queue to check current availability.
uncertain: It is unclear whether this assignment was recorded. Retry the same assignment.
accountChanged: Your signed-in account changed. Reload privacy settings to continue.
signedOut: Sign in again to use the reviewer queue.
securityTab: Account security in a new tab
securityHelp: Confirm your identity there, then return and explicitly retry here. An interrupted assignment keeps the same request.

errors.csrf_rejected: The security check failed. Retry after refreshing the page if needed.
errors.fresh_auth_required: Confirm your identity before loading or assigning requests.
errors.reviewer_changed: Your signed-in account changed. Reload privacy settings to continue.
errors.request_failed: The queue or assignment could not be confirmed. Try again.
errors.invalid_input: This request cannot be used. Refresh the queue before continuing.
errors.forbidden: These requests are unavailable for your account.
errors.not_found: This request is no longer available. Refresh the queue.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This retry does not match the original assignment. Ask the workspace operator for help.
errors.storage_unavailable: The queue or assignment could not be confirmed. Try again.
errors.stale_version: This request changed. Refresh the queue before another assignment.
errors.case_assigned: Another reviewer has taken this request. Refresh the queue.
errors.case_not_assignable: This request can no longer be taken from the intake queue. Refresh the queue.
errors.security_unavailable: Sign-in status is unavailable. Check it again before continuing.
errors.transport_interrupted: The connection was interrupted. Check sign-in and explicitly retry.
